import sys
import math

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return

    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))

    sx = float(next(it))
    sy = float(next(it))
    dx = float(next(it))
    dy = float(next(it))

    crystals = []
    for _ in range(n):
        x = float(next(it))
        y = float(next(it))
        crystals.append((x, y))

    # Time before each crystal is swallowed by miasma:
    # must arrive strictly earlier than dist(demon, crystal)
    deadlines = []
    for x, y in crystals:
        d = math.hypot(x - dx, y - dy)
        deadlines.append(d)

    # DP over subsets:
    # dp[mask][i] = minimum time to collect crystals in mask and finish at crystal i
    # while respecting deadlines for all visited crystals.
    INF = float('inf')
    m = 1 << n
    dp = [[INF] * n for _ in range(m)]

    for i in range(n):
        x, y = crystals[i]
        t = math.hypot(x - sx, y - sy)
        if t < deadlines[i]:
            dp[1 << i][i] = t

    for mask in range(m):
        for last in range(n):
            cur = dp[mask][last]
            if cur == INF:
                continue
            lx, ly = crystals[last]
            for nxt in range(n):
                if mask >> nxt & 1:
                    continue
                nx, ny = crystals[nxt]
                nt = cur + math.hypot(nx - lx, ny - ly)
                if nt < deadlines[nxt]:
                    nmask = mask | (1 << nxt)
                    if nt < dp[nmask][nxt]:
                        dp[nmask][nxt] = nt

    full = m - 1
    ok = any(dp[full][i] < INF for i in range(n)) if n > 0 else True
    print("YES" if ok else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
